d:
Your love. Your demand. A brand-new celebration.
As we say —
CELEBRATION MEANS DALER MEHNDI
Featuring Daler Mehndi himself in a lively dance performance, Moye Moye 2.0 is a burst of infectious rhythms, colourful visuals, and unstoppable festive energy. Designed especially for Lohri celebrations, this version captures joy, movement, and pure Punjabi pop madness in every beat.
Whether it’s reels, parties, or festive nights — this track is here to make every moment louder, brighter, and more memorable.
Turn it up. Groove hard. Celebrate louder.
